newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Black S.African beaten to death by gang of whites.
newsitem.headline: Black S.African beaten to death by gang of whites.

text.p: A black man was brutally beaten to death and six others injured by a gang of whites in an apparent race attack in South Africa's administrative capital Pretoria, police said on Sunday.
Police Captain Morne van Wyk said the attack happened at a small squatters camp in the suburb of Koedoespoort late on Friday night.

"A group of white males armed with batons and sjamboks (leather whips) started beating the squatters. One of the squatters was killed. He had multiple head injuries and also injuries to his body," van Wyk told Reuters.
Another black man was seriously injured during the attack, and was admitted to hospital for treatment, he said. Five other men were treated at the scene for minor injuries.
"We suspect it is a race attack," added van Wyk.
Witnesses said two whites had burst into a shack occupied by street traders, looking for a black man who had fled after they had nearly ran him over.

The occupants of the shack swore at the pair and told them to leave. The white men left without finding the man they wanted and promised to return to "beat you kaffirs" (derogatory term for blacks). Several hours later, they arrived at the shack with up to 18 of their friends, armed with batons and whips.
Police could not confirm the number of attackers, but said investigations were under way. There were no immediate arrests.

Race attacks have become a rare phenomenon in South Africa since President Nelson Mandela won power in 1994 all-race polls. Two years on, he continues to promote reconciliation between the races, split under almost five decades of apartheid.
